    def compute_metrics_datasets(
    self,
    ori_data: TableLike,
    dataset_dict: Mapping[str, TableLike],
    metrics: Union[str, Sequence[str], None] = None,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    Compute metrics for several synthetic datasets against one original result table.

    Args:
        ori_data (str | PathLike | pd.DataFrame): Original result table or path.
        dataset_dict (Mapping[str, str | PathLike | pd.DataFrame]): Dataset name -> table or path.
        metrics (str | Sequence[str] | None): As in :meth:`compute_metrics`.

    Returns:
        pd.DataFrame: One row per dataset (index "Dataset"), one column per metric.
    """
    names, _ = self._resolve_metrics(metrics)
    df_ori = self._load_df(ori_data)
    rows = {
        name: self.compute_metrics(df_ori, data, metrics=names)
        for name, data in dataset_dict.items()
    }
    out = pd.DataFrame.from_dict(rows, orient="index", columns=names)
    out.index.name = "Dataset"
    return out

    def concordance_score(self, df_rank: pd.DataFrame) -> ConcordanceResult:
    """
    Compute recall, precision and F1-score of the significant features.

    Args:
        df_rank (pd.DataFrame): Aligned rank table with rank_ori, rank_syn, q_ori, qval.

    Returns:
        ConcordanceResult: Scores and counts.
    """
    x = np.asarray(df_rank["rank_ori"].values)
    y = np.asarray(df_rank["rank_syn"].values)

    n_zone1, n_zone2, n_zone3, n_zone4 = self.zone_counts(x, y)
    n_sign = n_zone3 + n_zone4

    n_sig_ori = int((df_rank["q_ori"] < self.sig_thr).sum())
    n_sig_syn = int((df_rank["qval"] < self.sig_thr).sum())

    recall = n_sign / n_sig_ori if n_sig_ori > 0 else np.nan
    precision = n_sign / n_sig_syn if n_sig_syn > 0 else np.nan

    if n_sig_ori == 0:
        f1 = np.nan
    elif n_sign == 0:
        f1 = 0.0
    else:
        f1 = 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall)

    return ConcordanceResult(
        recall=float(recall),
        precision=float(precision),
        f1=float(f1),
        n_sign=n_sign,
        n_sig_ori=n_sig_ori,
        n_sig_syn=n_sig_syn,
        n_zone1=n_zone1,
        n_zone2=n_zone2,
        n_zone3=n_zone3,
        n_zone4=n_zone4,
        aligned_size=int(len(df_rank)),
    )

    def plot_calibration_scatter(
    self,
    ori_data: TableLike,
    dataset_dict: Mapping[str, TableLike],
    highlight: Optional[Mapping[str, Sequence[str]]] = None,
    ncols: int = 3,
    figsize: Optional[Tuple[float, float]] = None,
) -> Tuple[plt.Figure, pd.DataFrame]:
    """
    Plot synthetic versus original effect sizes of the features significant in the original.

    One panel per dataset, on shared axes. Dashed line y = x, red line the fit of
    ``slope_method``, grey points features with the opposite sign, shaded the discordant
    quadrants. With at most ``max_marked_features`` features per panel (e.g. pathways),
    filled points are also significant in the synthetic data and open points are not, the
    features not significant in the original are drawn in light grey (not part of the fit),
    and both axes share the range of all the effect sizes.
    The inset gives the slope, Pearson R and sign concordance.

    Args:
        ori_data (str | PathLike | pd.DataFrame): Original result table or path.
        dataset_dict (Mapping[str, str | PathLike | pd.DataFrame]): Dataset name -> table or path.
        highlight (Mapping[str, Sequence[str]] | None): Optional groups of feature names
            drawn on top of each panel, e.g. {"MHC-I": [...], "MHC-II": [...]}.
        ncols (int): Number of panel columns.
        figsize (tuple[float, float] | None): Figure size; defaults to 3.5 x 3.7 per panel.

    Returns:
        tuple[matplotlib.figure.Figure, pd.DataFrame]: (figure, calibration metrics per dataset).
    """
    df_ori = self._load_df(ori_data)
    merged = {name: self.merge_effects(df_ori, data) for name, data in dataset_dict.items()}
    points = {name: self._calibration_points_sig(m) for name, m in merged.items()}

    # few features (pathways): large markers, filled when significant in the synthetic too,
    # with the features not significant in the original as context, on one range of all the
    # effect sizes for both axes; many features (genes): small markers on symmetric axes
    few = max((len(p[0]) for p in points.values()), default=0) <= self.max_marked_features
    if few:
        all_effects = np.concatenate([m[["effect_ori", "effect_syn"]].to_numpy(float).ravel()
                                      for m in merged.values()])
        xlim = ylim = _axis_range(all_effects)
    else:
        all_xy = np.concatenate([np.abs(np.concatenate(p[:2])) for p in points.values()])
        lim = float(np.nanpercentile(all_xy, 99.5)) * 1.08 if all_xy.size else 1.0
        lim = math.ceil(lim * 10) / 10
        xlim = ylim = (-lim, lim)

    n = len(dataset_dict)
    ncols = max(1, min(ncols, n))
    nrows = int(math.ceil(n / ncols))
    if figsize is None:
        figsize = (3.5 * ncols, 3.7 * nrows)
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(nrows, ncols, figsize=figsize, sharex=True, sharey=True, squeeze=False)
    flat = axes.ravel()

    rows = {}
    for ax, name in zip(flat, dataset_dict):
        x, y, syn_sig = points[name]
        res = self.calibration_score(merged[name])
        rows[name] = res
        same = np.sign(x) == np.sign(y)
        color = DATASET_COLORS.get(name, CALIBRATION_COLORS["default_point"])

        ax.fill_between([0, xlim[1]], ylim[0], 0, color=CALIBRATION_COLORS["discordant_bg"], zorder=0, lw=0)
        ax.fill_between([xlim[0], 0], 0, ylim[1], color=CALIBRATION_COLORS["discordant_bg"], zorder=0, lw=0)
        if few:
            rest = merged[name][merged[name]["sig_ori"] >= self.sig_thr]
            ax.scatter(rest["effect_ori"], rest["effect_syn"], s=16, c=CALIBRATION_COLORS["context"],
                       edgecolors="none", zorder=1)
            colors = np.where(same, color, CALIBRATION_COLORS["opposite_sign"])
            ax.scatter(x[syn_sig], y[syn_sig], s=48, c=colors[syn_sig], edgecolors="#444444",
                       linewidths=0.6, zorder=3)
            ax.scatter(x[~syn_sig], y[~syn_sig], s=48, facecolors="white", edgecolors=colors[~syn_sig],
                       linewidths=1.4, zorder=3)
        else:
            ax.scatter(x[same], y[same], s=6, c=color, alpha=0.55, edgecolors="none", zorder=2)
            ax.scatter(x[~same], y[~same], s=6, c=CALIBRATION_COLORS["opposite_sign"], alpha=0.45,
                       edgecolors="none", zorder=2)

        grid = np.array([min(xlim[0], ylim[0]), max(xlim[1], ylim[1])])
        ax.plot(grid, grid, ls="--", color=CALIBRATION_COLORS["identity"], lw=0.9, zorder=3)
        if np.isfinite(res["Slope"]):
            fx = np.array(xlim)
            ax.plot(fx, res["Slope"] * fx + res["Intercept"], color=CALIBRATION_COLORS["fit"],
                    lw=1.6, zorder=4)
        ax.axhline(0, color="black", lw=0.4, alpha=0.4)
        ax.axvline(0, color="black", lw=0.4, alpha=0.4)

        if highlight:
            m = merged[name]
            for idx, members in enumerate(highlight.values()):
                mm = m[m[self.term_col].isin(members)]
                ax.scatter(mm["effect_ori"], mm["effect_syn"], s=16,
                           c=HIGHLIGHT_GROUP_COLORS[idx % len(HIGHLIGHT_GROUP_COLORS)],
                           edgecolors="white", linewidths=0.4, zorder=5)

        txt = (f"slope {res['Slope']:.2f}\nR {res['Pearson']:.2f}\n"
               f"sign conc. {res['SignConcordance']:.2f}")
        ax.text(0.03, 0.97, txt, transform=ax.transAxes, ha="left", va="top", fontsize=7.5,
                bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.25", fc="white", ec="#cccccc", lw=0.5, alpha=0.9),
                zorder=6)
        ax.set_title(name, fontsize=11, fontweight="bold", color=DATASET_COLORS.get(name, "black"))
        ax.set_xlim(*xlim)
        ax.set_ylim(*ylim)
        ax.set_box_aspect(1)
        ax.tick_params(labelsize=8)

    for ax in flat[n:]:
        ax.set_visible(False)
    for c in range(ncols):
        # the lowest visible panel of each column carries the x axis
        col_axes = [axes[r, c] for r in range(nrows) if r * ncols + c < n]
        if col_axes:
            col_axes[-1].set_xlabel(
                f"{self.nes_col} original" if few
                else f"{self.nes_col} original ({self.sig_col} < {self.sig_thr:g})", fontsize=9
            )
            col_axes[-1].xaxis.set_tick_params(labelbottom=True)
    for ax in axes[:, 0]:
        ax.set_ylabel(f"{self.nes_col} synthetic", fontsize=9)

    handles = [
        Line2D([], [], ls="--", color=CALIBRATION_COLORS["identity"], label="y = x"),
        Line2D([], [], color=CALIBRATION_COLORS["fit"], lw=1.6,
               label="Theil-Sen fit" if self.slope_method == "theil-sen" else "OLS fit"),
        Line2D([], [], marker="o", ls="", color=CALIBRATION_COLORS["opposite_sign"],
               label="opposite sign", ms=7 if few else 4),
    ]
    if few:
        handles[2:2] = [
            Line2D([], [], marker="o", ls="", mfc="#777777", mec="#444444", ms=7,
                   label=f"significant in synthetic ({self.sig_col} < {self.sig_thr:g})"),
            Line2D([], [], marker="o", ls="", mfc="white", mec="#777777", mew=1.4, ms=7,
                   label="not significant in synthetic"),
        ]
        handles.append(Line2D([], [], marker="o", ls="", color=CALIBRATION_COLORS["context"], ms=4.5,
                              label="not significant in original"))
    if highlight:
        handles += [
            Line2D([], [], marker="o", ls="", ms=5, label=group,
                   color=HIGHLIGHT_GROUP_COLORS[idx % len(HIGHLIGHT_GROUP_COLORS)])
            for idx, group in enumerate(highlight)
        ]
    fig.legend(handles=handles, loc="lower center", ncol=3 if few else len(handles), fontsize=8,
               frameon=False, bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.06 if few else -0.035))
    fig.tight_layout(rect=(0, 0.02, 1, 1))

    table = pd.DataFrame.from_dict(rows, orient="index")
    table.index.name = "Dataset"
    return fig, table

    def process_single_result(
    self,
    res_ori: TableLike,
    res_syn: TableLike,
) -> Tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, ConcordanceResult]:
    """
    Process original and synthetic result tables (paths or DataFrames).

    Args:
        res_ori (str | PathLike | pd.DataFrame): Original result table.
        res_syn (str | PathLike | pd.DataFrame): Synthetic result table.

    Returns:
        tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, ConcordanceResult]: (x, y, result).
    """
    rnk_ori = self.rank_score(self._load_df(res_ori))
    rnk_syn = self.rank_score(self._load_df(res_syn))
    aligned = self.align_rank_scores(rnk_ori, rnk_syn)

    x = aligned["rank_ori"].values
    y = aligned["rank_syn"].values
    return x, y, self.concordance_score(aligned)

    def rank_score(self, df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    Compute rank score = sign(effect) * -log10(significance) with tiny jitter.

    Significance values are clipped at 0.001 before the log transform.

    Args:
        df (pd.DataFrame): Result table.

    Returns:
        pd.DataFrame: Ranked table indexed by term_col with columns rank_score and qval.
    """
    q = pd.to_numeric(df[self.sig_col], errors="coerce").clip(lower=0.001)
    nes = pd.to_numeric(df[self.nes_col], errors="coerce")

    rank_score = np.sign(nes) * (-np.log10(q))

    jitter = np.random.RandomState(self.seed).uniform(-1e-10, 1e-10, size=len(rank_score))
    rank_score = rank_score + jitter

    rnk = (
        df[[self.term_col]]
        .assign(rank_score=rank_score, qval=q)
        .dropna()
        .groupby(self.term_col)
        .mean()
        .sort_values("rank_score", ascending=False)
    )
    return rnk

    def zone_counts(self, x: np.ndarray, y: np.ndarray) -> Tuple[int, int, int, int]:
    """
    Count features in the four concordance zones of the rank-score plane.

    Zones 1-2 hold features non-significant in both tables with the same sign, zones
    3-4 features significant in both with the same sign.

    Args:
        x (np.ndarray): Original rank scores.
        y (np.ndarray): Synthetic rank scores.

    Returns:
        tuple[int, int, int, int]: (n_zone1, n_zone2, n_zone3, n_zone4).
    """
    s_thr = -np.log10(self.sig_thr)
    n_zone1 = int(((x >= -s_thr) & (x <= 0) & (y >= -s_thr) & (y <= 0)).sum())
    n_zone2 = int(((x >= 0) & (x <= s_thr) & (y >= 0) & (y <= s_thr)).sum())
    n_zone3 = int(((x <= -s_thr) & (y <= -s_thr)).sum())
    n_zone4 = int(((x >= s_thr) & (y >= s_thr)).sum())
    return n_zone1, n_zone2, n_zone3, n_zone4

class ConcordanceResult:
    """
    Significance concordance between an original and a synthetic result table.

    A feature (gene or pathway) is significant when its significance value is below the
    threshold; it is concordant when it is significant in both tables with the same
    effect-size sign.

    Args:
        recall (float): n_sign / n_sig_ori (NaN when the original has no significant feature).
        precision (float): n_sign / n_sig_syn (NaN when the synthetic has no significant feature).
        f1 (float): Harmonic mean of precision and recall; 0 when no feature is concordant.
        n_sign (int): Number of concordant significant features (zones 3 + 4).
        n_sig_ori (int): Number of significant features in the original table.
        n_sig_syn (int): Number of significant features in the synthetic table.
        n_zone1 (int): Count in non-significant lower-left zone.
        n_zone2 (int): Count in non-significant upper-right zone.
        n_zone3 (int): Count in significant lower-left zone.
        n_zone4 (int): Count in significant upper-right zone.
        aligned_size (int): Number of features after alignment (inner join).

    precision: float

    n_sign: int
    n_sig_ori: int
    n_sig_syn: int
    n_zone1: int
    n_zone2: int

    class GCSAnalyzer(ConcordanceAnalyzer):
    """
    Gene-level concordance (GCS) between original and synthetic DGE results.

    Reports recall, precision and F1-score of the differentially expressed genes
    (F1-GCS), and the effect-size calibration of the original DEGs: OLS slope of the
    Log2FC, Pearson correlation and sign concordance.

    Args:
        term_col (str): Gene name column.
        nes_col (str): Effect-size column (e.g., Log2FC).
        sig_col (str): Significance column; P-value or Q-value, as the user decides.
        seed (int): Seed of the tiny jitter added to the rank scores.
        sig_thr (float): Significance threshold applied to ``sig_col``.

    Raises:
        ValueError: If sig_thr is not in (0, 1].
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        term_col: str = "Gene",
        nes_col: str = "Log2FC",
        sig_col: str = "P_value",
        seed: int = 42,
        sig_thr: float = 0.05,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(term_col=term_col, nes_col=nes_col, sig_col=sig_col, seed=seed, sig_thr=sig_thr)

    def compute_rank_score(self, df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        """
        Compute rank score = sign(Log2FC) * -log10(significance) with tiny jitter.

        Args:
            df (pd.DataFrame): DGE results table.

        Returns:
            pd.DataFrame: Ranked table indexed by term_col with columns rank_score and qval.
        """
        return self.rank_score(df)

    def gene_set_concordance_score(self, df_rank: pd.DataFrame) -> ConcordanceResult:
        """
        Compute recall, precision and F1-score of the differentially expressed genes.

        Args:
            df_rank (pd.DataFrame): Aligned rank table with rank_ori, rank_syn, q_ori, qval.

        Returns:
            ConcordanceResult: Scores and counts.
        """
        return self.concordance_score(df_rank)

    def process_single_dge_result(
        self,
        dge_ori: Union[str, "os.PathLike[str]", pd.DataFrame],
        dge_syn: Union[str, "os.PathLike[str]", pd.DataFrame],
    ) -> Tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, ConcordanceResult]:
        """
        Process original and synthetic DGE results (paths or DataFrames).

        Args:
            dge_ori (str | PathLike | pd.DataFrame): Original DGE table/path.
            dge_syn (str | PathLike | pd.DataFrame): Synthetic DGE table/path.

        Returns:
            tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, ConcordanceResult]: (x, y, result).
        """
        return self.process_single_result(dge_ori, dge_syn)

    def plot_single_gcs_panel(
        self,
        ax: plt.Axes,
        x: np.ndarray,
        y: np.ndarray,
        result: ConcordanceResult,
        tool_name: str,
    ) -> None:
        """
        Plot one gene-level concordance panel in the rank-score plane.

        Args:
            ax (matplotlib.axes.Axes): Target axis.
            x (np.ndarray): Rank scores (original).
            y (np.ndarray): Rank scores (synthetic).
            result (ConcordanceResult): Concordance result.
            tool_name (str): Tool/dataset name for title.

        Returns:
            None
        """
        s_thr = -np.log10(self.sig_thr)
        lo, hi = -2, 2

        zone1 = (x >= -s_thr) & (x <= 0) & (y >= -s_thr) & (y <= 0)
        zone2 = (x >= 0) & (x <= s_thr) & (y >= 0) & (y <= s_thr)
        zone3 = (x <= -s_thr) & (y <= -s_thr)
        zone4 = (x >= s_thr) & (y >= s_thr)
        other = ~(zone1 | zone2 | zone3 | zone4)

        ax.add_patch(
            plt.Rectangle((-s_thr, -s_thr), s_thr, s_thr, color=GCS_ZONE_BG_COLORS["zone1"], alpha=0.4)
        )
        ax.add_patch(
            plt.Rectangle((0, 0), s_thr, s_thr, color=GCS_ZONE_BG_COLORS["zone2"], alpha=0.4)
        )
        ax.add_patch(
            plt.Rectangle((lo, lo), -s_thr - lo, -s_thr - lo, color=GCS_ZONE_BG_COLORS["zone3"], alpha=0.2)
        )
        ax.add_patch(
            plt.Rectangle((s_thr, s_thr), hi - s_thr, hi - s_thr, color=GCS_ZONE_BG_COLORS["zone4"], alpha=0.2)
        )

        ax.scatter(x[other], y[other], c=GCS_ZONE_COLORS["other"], alpha=0.3, s=20)
        ax.scatter(x[zone1], y[zone1], c=GCS_ZONE_COLORS["zone1"], s=60, edgecolor="k")
        ax.scatter(x[zone2], y[zone2], c=GCS_ZONE_COLORS["zone2"], s=60, edgecolor="k")
        ax.scatter(x[zone3], y[zone3], c=GCS_ZONE_COLORS["zone3"], s=70, edgecolor="k")
        ax.scatter(x[zone4], y[zone4], c=GCS_ZONE_COLORS["zone4"], s=70, edgecolor="k")

        ax.plot([lo, hi], [lo, hi], "--", c="black", lw=1)
        for v in [-s_thr, 0, s_thr]:
            ax.axhline(v, ls=":", c="black", lw=1 if v != 0 else 0.5)
            ax.axvline(v, ls=":", c="black", lw=1 if v != 0 else 0.5)

        ax.set_xlim(lo, hi)
        ax.set_ylim(lo, hi)
        ax.set_xlabel("Rank score (Original)")
        ax.set_ylabel("Rank score (Synthetic)")
        ax.set_title(f"{tool_name}\nF1-GCS={result.f1:.3f}")

        ax.text(
            -1.9,
            1.8,
            "Zones\n"
            f"NonSig LL: {result.n_zone1}\n"
            f"NonSig UR: {result.n_zone2}\n"
            f"Sig LL: {result.n_zone3}\n"
            f"Sig UR: {result.n_zone4}\n"
            f"Recall={result.recall:.3f}\n"
            f"Precision={result.precision:.3f}",
            fontsize=10,
            va="top",
            bbox=dict(fc="white", alpha=0.7, ec="none"),
        )

        ax.grid(True)

    def plot_gcs_datasets(
        self,
        ori_data: Union[str, "os.PathLike[str]", pd.DataFrame],
        dataset_dict: Mapping[str, Union[str, "os.PathLike[str]", pd.DataFrame]],
        figsize: Tuple[int, int] = (18, 10),
    ) -> Tuple[plt.Figure, Dict[str, float]]:
        """
        Plot all datasets in a grid.

        Args:
            ori_data (str | PathLike | pd.DataFrame): Path to original CSV or DataFrame.
            dataset_dict (Mapping[str, str | PathLike | pd.DataFrame]): Tool name -> path or DataFrame.
            figsize (tuple[int, int]): Figure size.

        Returns:
            tuple[matplotlib.figure.Figure, dict[str, float]]: (figure, F1-GCS per dataset).
        """
        df_ori = self._load_df(ori_data)

        fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=figsize)
        axes = axes.flatten()

        f1_dict: Dict[str, float] = {}

        for idx, (tool, data) in enumerate(dataset_dict.items()):
            try:
                x, y, result = self.process_single_dge_result(df_ori, data)
                self.plot_single_gcs_panel(axes[idx], x, y, result, tool)
                f1_dict[tool] = result.f1

            except Exception as e:
                print(f"Skipping {tool}: {e}")

        for j in range(len(dataset_dict), len(axes)):
            fig.delaxes(axes[j])

        plt.tight_layout()
        plt.show()

        return fig, f1_dict

    df_ori = self._load_df(ori_data)

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=figsize)
    axes = axes.flatten()

    f1_dict: Dict[str, float] = {}

    for idx, (tool, data) in enumerate(dataset_dict.items()):
        try:
            x, y, result = self.process_single_dge_result(df_ori, data)
            self.plot_single_gcs_panel(axes[idx], x, y, result, tool)
            f1_dict[tool] = result.f1

        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Skipping {tool}: {e}")

    for j in range(len(dataset_dict), len(axes)):
        fig.delaxes(axes[j])

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

    return fig, f1_dict

    def plot_single_gcs_panel(
    self,
    ax: plt.Axes,
    x: np.ndarray,
    y: np.ndarray,
    result: ConcordanceResult,
    tool_name: str,
) -> None:
    """
    Plot one gene-level concordance panel in the rank-score plane.

    Args:
        ax (matplotlib.axes.Axes): Target axis.
        x (np.ndarray): Rank scores (original).
        y (np.ndarray): Rank scores (synthetic).
        result (ConcordanceResult): Concordance result.
        tool_name (str): Tool/dataset name for title.

    Returns:
        None
    """
    s_thr = -np.log10(self.sig_thr)
    lo, hi = -2, 2

    zone1 = (x >= -s_thr) & (x <= 0) & (y >= -s_thr) & (y <= 0)
    zone2 = (x >= 0) & (x <= s_thr) & (y >= 0) & (y <= s_thr)
    zone3 = (x <= -s_thr) & (y <= -s_thr)
    zone4 = (x >= s_thr) & (y >= s_thr)
    other = ~(zone1 | zone2 | zone3 | zone4)

    ax.add_patch(
        plt.Rectangle((-s_thr, -s_thr), s_thr, s_thr, color=GCS_ZONE_BG_COLORS["zone1"], alpha=0.4)
    )
    ax.add_patch(
        plt.Rectangle((0, 0), s_thr, s_thr, color=GCS_ZONE_BG_COLORS["zone2"], alpha=0.4)
    )
    ax.add_patch(
        plt.Rectangle((lo, lo), -s_thr - lo, -s_thr - lo, color=GCS_ZONE_BG_COLORS["zone3"], alpha=0.2)
    )
    ax.add_patch(
        plt.Rectangle((s_thr, s_thr), hi - s_thr, hi - s_thr, color=GCS_ZONE_BG_COLORS["zone4"], alpha=0.2)
    )

    ax.scatter(x[other], y[other], c=GCS_ZONE_COLORS["other"], alpha=0.3, s=20)
    ax.scatter(x[zone1], y[zone1], c=GCS_ZONE_COLORS["zone1"], s=60, edgecolor="k")
    ax.scatter(x[zone2], y[zone2], c=GCS_ZONE_COLORS["zone2"], s=60, edgecolor="k")
    ax.scatter(x[zone3], y[zone3], c=GCS_ZONE_COLORS["zone3"], s=70, edgecolor="k")
    ax.scatter(x[zone4], y[zone4], c=GCS_ZONE_COLORS["zone4"], s=70, edgecolor="k")

    ax.plot([lo, hi], [lo, hi], "--", c="black", lw=1)
    for v in [-s_thr, 0, s_thr]:
        ax.axhline(v, ls=":", c="black", lw=1 if v != 0 else 0.5)
        ax.axvline(v, ls=":", c="black", lw=1 if v != 0 else 0.5)

    ax.set_xlim(lo, hi)
    ax.set_ylim(lo, hi)
    ax.set_xlabel("Rank score (Original)")
    ax.set_ylabel("Rank score (Synthetic)")
    ax.set_title(f"{tool_name}\nF1-GCS={result.f1:.3f}")

    ax.text(
        -1.9,
        1.8,
        "Zones\n"
        f"NonSig LL: {result.n_zone1}\n"
        f"NonSig UR: {result.n_zone2}\n"
        f"Sig LL: {result.n_zone3}\n"
        f"Sig UR: {result.n_zone4}\n"
        f"Recall={result.recall:.3f}\n"
        f"Precision={result.precision:.3f}",
        fontsize=10,
        va="top",
        bbox=dict(fc="white", alpha=0.7, ec="none"),
    )

    ax.grid(True)

    class PCSAnalyzer(ConcordanceAnalyzer):
    """
    Pathway-level concordance (PCS) between original and synthetic GSEA results.

    Reports recall, precision and F1-score of the enriched pathways (F1-PCS), and the
    effect-size calibration of the pathways enriched in the original: Theil-Sen slope of
    the NES (robust with the few significant pathways), Pearson correlation and sign
    concordance.

    Args:
        term_col (str): Pathway term column name.
        nes_col (str): Normalized enrichment score column name.
        sig_col (str): Significance column; FDR q-value or nominal P-value, as the user decides.
        seed (int): Seed of the tiny jitter added to the rank scores.
        sig_thr (float): Significance threshold applied to ``sig_col``.

    Raises:
        ValueError: If sig_thr is not in (0, 1].
    """

    slope_method = "theil-sen"

    def __init__(
        self,
        term_col: str = "Term",
        nes_col: str = "NES",
        sig_col: str = "FDR q-val",
        seed: int = 42,
        sig_thr: float = 0.05,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(term_col=term_col, nes_col=nes_col, sig_col=sig_col, seed=seed, sig_thr=sig_thr)

    def gsea_rank_score(self, df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        """
        Compute pathway rank score = sign(NES) * -log10(significance) with tiny jitter.

        Args:
            df (pd.DataFrame): GSEA results table.

        Returns:
            pd.DataFrame: Ranked table indexed by term_col with columns rank_score and qval.

        Raises:
            KeyError: If required columns are missing.
        """
        return self.rank_score(df)

    def pathway_concordance_score(self, df_rank: pd.DataFrame) -> ConcordanceResult:
        """
        Compute recall, precision and F1-score of the enriched pathways.

        Args:
            df_rank (pd.DataFrame): Aligned rank table with rank_ori, rank_syn, q_ori, qval.

        Returns:
            ConcordanceResult: Scores and counts.
        """
        return self.concordance_score(df_rank)

    def process_single_gsea_result(
        self,
        gsea_ori: Union[str, "os.PathLike[str]", pd.DataFrame],
        gsea_syn: Union[str, "os.PathLike[str]", pd.DataFrame],
    ) -> Tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, ConcordanceResult]:
        """
        Process original and synthetic GSEA results (paths or DataFrames).

        Args:
            gsea_ori (str | PathLike | pd.DataFrame): Original GSEA table.
            gsea_syn (str | PathLike | pd.DataFrame): Synthetic GSEA table.

        Returns:
            tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, ConcordanceResult]: (x, y, result).
        """
        return self.process_single_result(gsea_ori, gsea_syn)

    def plot_single_gsea_panel(
        self,
        ax: plt.Axes,
        x: np.ndarray,
        y: np.ndarray,
        result: ConcordanceResult,
        tool_name: str,
        show_xlabel: bool = False,
    ) -> None:
        """
        Plot one pathway-level concordance panel in the rank-score plane.

        Args:
            ax (matplotlib.axes.Axes): Matplotlib axis.
            x (np.ndarray): Original rank scores.
            y (np.ndarray): Synthetic rank scores.
            result (ConcordanceResult): Concordance result.
            tool_name (str): Tool name for title.
            show_xlabel (bool): Whether to show x-axis label/ticks.

        Returns:
            None
        """
        s_thr = -np.log10(self.sig_thr)
        lo, hi = -3, 3

        zone1 = (x >= -s_thr) & (x <= 0) & (y >= -s_thr) & (y <= 0)
        zone2 = (x >= 0) & (x <= s_thr) & (y >= 0) & (y <= s_thr)
        zone3 = (x <= -s_thr) & (y <= -s_thr)
        zone4 = (x >= s_thr) & (y >= s_thr)
        other = ~(zone1 | zone2 | zone3 | zone4)

        ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((-s_thr, -s_thr), s_thr, s_thr, color="#d0d0f4", alpha=0.4))
        ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((0, 0), s_thr, s_thr, color="#d0f4d0", alpha=0.4))
        ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((lo, lo), -s_thr - lo, -s_thr - lo, color="#89a5e6", alpha=0.2))
        ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((s_thr, s_thr), hi - s_thr, hi - s_thr, color="#66e699", alpha=0.2))

        ax.scatter(x[other], y[other], c="gray", alpha=0.3, s=20)
        ax.scatter(x[zone1], y[zone1], c="#38499b", s=60, edgecolor="k")
        ax.scatter(x[zone2], y[zone2], c="#239933", s=60, edgecolor="k")
        ax.scatter(x[zone3], y[zone3], c="#222e5c", s=70, edgecolor="k")
        ax.scatter(x[zone4], y[zone4], c="#13753a", s=70, edgecolor="k")

        ax.plot([lo, hi], [lo, hi], "--", c="black", lw=1)
        for v in [-s_thr, 0, s_thr]:
            ax.axhline(v, ls=":", c="black", lw=1 if v != 0 else 0.5)
            ax.axvline(v, ls=":", c="black", lw=1 if v != 0 else 0.5)

        ax.set_xlim(lo, hi)
        ax.set_ylim(lo, hi)

        if show_xlabel:
            ax.set_xlabel("Rank score (Original)")
        else:
            ax.set_xlabel("")
            ax.tick_params(axis="x", labelbottom=False)

        ax.set_ylabel("Rank score\n(Synthetic)")

        title_color = DATASET_COLORS.get(tool_name, "black")
        ax.set_title(
            f"{tool_name}\nF1-PCS={result.f1:.3f}",
            fontsize=12,
            color=title_color,
            fontweight="bold",
        )

        ax.text(
            -2.9,
            2.8,
            f"NonSig LL: {result.n_zone1}\n"
            f"NonSig UR: {result.n_zone2}\n"
            f"Sig LL: {result.n_zone3}\n"
            f"Sig UR: {result.n_zone4}\n"
            f"Recall={result.recall:.3f}\n"
            f"Precision={result.precision:.3f}",
            fontsize=10,
            va="top",
            bbox=dict(fc="white", alpha=0.7, ec="none"),
        )

        ax.grid(True)

    def plot_gsea_datasets(
        self,
        ori_data: Union[str, "os.PathLike[str]", pd.DataFrame],
        dataset_dict: Mapping[str, Union[str, "os.PathLike[str]", pd.DataFrame]],
        figsize: Tuple[float, float] = (9, 10),
    ) -> Tuple[plt.Figure, Dict[str, float]]:
        """
        Plot multiple synthetic datasets against one original GSEA file.

        Args:
            ori_data (str | PathLike | pd.DataFrame): Original GSEA data or path.
            dataset_dict (Mapping[str, str | PathLike | pd.DataFrame]): Tool name -> synthetic data or path.
            figsize (tuple[float, float]): Figure size.

        Returns:
            tuple[matplotlib.figure.Figure, dict[str, float]]: (fig, F1-PCS per dataset).
        """
        df_ori = self._load_df(ori_data)

        fig, axes = plt.subplots(3, 2, figsize=figsize, constrained_layout=True)
        axes = axes.flatten()

        f1_dict: Dict[str, float] = {}

        for idx, (tool, data) in enumerate(dataset_dict.items()):
            try:
                x, y, result = self.process_single_gsea_result(df_ori, data)

                row = idx // 2
                is_bottom = row == 2

                self.plot_single_gsea_panel(
                    axes[idx],
                    x,
                    y,
                    result,
                    tool,
                    show_xlabel=is_bottom,
                )

                f1_dict[tool] = result.f1
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"Skipping {tool}: {e}")

        for j in range(len(dataset_dict), len(axes)):
            fig.delaxes(axes[j])

        plt.tight_layout()
        plt.show()

        return fig, f1_dict

    """
    s_thr = -np.log10(self.sig_thr)
    lo, hi = -3, 3

    zone1 = (x >= -s_thr) & (x <= 0) & (y >= -s_thr) & (y <= 0)
    zone2 = (x >= 0) & (x <= s_thr) & (y >= 0) & (y <= s_thr)
    zone3 = (x <= -s_thr) & (y <= -s_thr)
    zone4 = (x >= s_thr) & (y >= s_thr)
    other = ~(zone1 | zone2 | zone3 | zone4)

    ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((-s_thr, -s_thr), s_thr, s_thr, color="#d0d0f4", alpha=0.4))
    ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((0, 0), s_thr, s_thr, color="#d0f4d0", alpha=0.4))
    ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((lo, lo), -s_thr - lo, -s_thr - lo, color="#89a5e6", alpha=0.2))
    ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((s_thr, s_thr), hi - s_thr, hi - s_thr, color="#66e699", alpha=0.2))

    ax.scatter(x[other], y[other], c="gray", alpha=0.3, s=20)
    ax.scatter(x[zone1], y[zone1], c="#38499b", s=60, edgecolor="k")
    ax.scatter(x[zone2], y[zone2], c="#239933", s=60, edgecolor="k")
    ax.scatter(x[zone3], y[zone3], c="#222e5c", s=70, edgecolor="k")
    ax.scatter(x[zone4], y[zone4], c="#13753a", s=70, edgecolor="k")

    ax.plot([lo, hi], [lo, hi], "--", c="black", lw=1)
    for v in [-s_thr, 0, s_thr]:
        ax.axhline(v, ls=":", c="black", lw=1 if v != 0 else 0.5)
        ax.axvline(v, ls=":", c="black", lw=1 if v != 0 else 0.5)

    ax.set_xlim(lo, hi)
    ax.set_ylim(lo, hi)

    if show_xlabel:
        ax.set_xlabel("Rank score (Original)")
    else:
        ax.set_xlabel("")
        ax.tick_params(axis="x", labelbottom=False)

    ax.set_ylabel("Rank score\n(Synthetic)")

    title_color = DATASET_COLORS.get(tool_name, "black")
    ax.set_title(
        f"{tool_name}\nF1-PCS={result.f1:.3f}",
        fontsize=12,
        color=title_color,
        fontweight="bold",
    )

    ax.text(
        -2.9,
        2.8,
        f"NonSig LL: {result.n_zone1}\n"
        f"NonSig UR: {result.n_zone2}\n"
        f"Sig LL: {result.n_zone3}\n"
        f"Sig UR: {result.n_zone4}\n"
        f"Recall={result.recall:.3f}\n"
        f"Precision={result.precision:.3f}",
        fontsize=10,
        va="top",
        bbox=dict(fc="white", alpha=0.7, ec="none"),
    )

    ax.grid(True)

    Aitchison distance for compositional cell-type deconvolution data.

    Provides functions to compute the Aitchison distance between immune cell composition profiles estimated by CIBERSORTx (or similar tools) on original and synthetic datasets.

    The Aitchison distance is computed in Centered Log-Ratio (CLR) space after multiplicative replacement of zeros and geometric mean centering.

    aitchison_distance(df_orig, df_syn, cell_types) ¶

    def aitchison_distance(
    df_orig: pd.DataFrame,
    df_syn: pd.DataFrame,
    cell_types: List[str],
) -> float:
    """Compute the Aitchison distance between two cell-type composition datasets.

    The distance is defined as the Euclidean distance between the CLR-
    transformed compositional centers of the original and synthetic datasets.

    Args:
        df_orig: Original CIBERSORTx results (rows = samples, columns include
            the cell-type columns).
        df_syn: Synthetic CIBERSORTx results with the same cell-type columns.
        cell_types: List of column names for the cell types to compare.

    Returns:
        Aitchison distance (non-negative float).
    """
    data_orig = df_orig[cell_types].values.astype(float)
    data_syn = df_syn[cell_types].values.astype(float)

    # Replace zeros via multiplicative strategy
    data_orig_filled = multi_replace(data_orig)
    data_syn_filled = multi_replace(data_syn)

    # Compute compositional centers
    center_orig = geometric_center(data_orig_filled)
    center_syn = geometric_center(data_syn_filled)

    # CLR transform the centers
    clr_orig = clr(center_orig.reshape(1, -1)).flatten()
    clr_syn = clr(center_syn.reshape(1, -1)).flatten()

    # Euclidean distance in CLR space
    return euclidean(clr_orig, clr_syn)

    def aitchison_score(distance: float) -> float:
    """Convert Aitchison distance to a similarity score via exp(-d).

    Higher values indicate better agreement.  A distance of 0 yields a
    score of 1.0.

    Args:
        distance: Non-negative Aitchison distance.

    Returns:
        Score in (0, 1].
    """
    return float(np.exp(-distance))

    def geometric_center(X: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Compute the compositional center (geometric mean) for each component.

    Args:
        X: 2-D array of shape (n_samples, n_parts).

    Returns:
        1-D array of length n_parts representing the geometric mean per part.
    """
    return np.exp(np.mean(np.log(X), axis=0))

    class SurvivalEvaluator:
    """
    Perform survival analysis and visualization across multiple datasets
    comparing two phenotype groups.

    Args:
        datasets_dict (Dict[str, pd.DataFrame]): Mapping from dataset names to DataFrames.
        phenotype (Dict[str, List[Any]]): {column_name: [value_A, value_B]}, specifying the phenotype column and comparison values.
        time_target (str): Name of the survival time column.
        event_target (str): Name of the event indicator column.
        dataset_order (Optional[List[str]]): Custom plotting order for datasets. If None, use input order.
        dataset_colors (Optional[Dict[str, str]]): Colors for dataset annotation strips.
        group_colors (Optional[Dict[str, str]]): Colors for phenotype groups (A, B).
        font_scale (float): Global scaling for plot text sizes.

    Returns:
        None

    Raises:
        ValueError: If datasets_dict is empty or phenotype is not a {col: [A,B]} dict.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        datasets_dict: Dict[str, pd.DataFrame],
        phenotype: Dict[str, List[Any]],
        time_target: str = "OS",
        event_target: str = "OS_CNSR",
        dataset_order: Optional[List[str]] = None,
        dataset_colors: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
        group_colors: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
        font_scale: float = 1.0,
        is_pdf: bool = False,
        original_name: str = "Origin"
    ) -> None:
        """
        Initialize SurvivalGridEvaluator for grid-based survival comparison.

        Args:
            datasets_dict (Dict[str, pd.DataFrame]): Input datasets.
            phenotype (Dict[str, List[Any]]): {col: [value_A, value_B]}.
            time_target (str): Survival duration column.
            event_target (str): Event indicator column.
            dataset_order (List[str], optional): Custom dataset plotting order.
            dataset_colors (Dict[str, str], optional): Strip colors per dataset.
            group_colors (Dict[str, str], optional): Colors for phenotype groups.
            font_scale (float): Plot font scaling.
            is_pdf (boolean): save as pdf or png.
            original_name (str): Name of the reference dataset (default: "Origin").

        Returns:
            None

        Raises:
            ValueError: On empty datasets or invalid phenotype specification.
        """
        if not datasets_dict:
            raise ValueError("datasets_dict must not be empty.")
        if not isinstance(phenotype, dict) or len(phenotype) != 1:
            raise ValueError("phenotype must be a dict with one mapping {column_name: [valA, valB]}.")
        ph_column, ph_values = next(iter(phenotype.items()))
        if not isinstance(ph_values, (list, tuple)) or len(ph_values) != 2:
            raise ValueError("phenotype value must be a list/tuple of exactly two values: [value_A, value_B].")
        self.datasets_dict = datasets_dict
        self.phenotype_column = ph_column
        self.value_A, self.value_B = ph_values
        self.time_target = time_target
        self.event_target = event_target
        self.dataset_order = dataset_order
        self.dataset_colors = dataset_colors or DATASET_COLORS.copy()
        self.group_colors = group_colors or GROUP_COLORS.copy()
        self.font_scale = font_scale
        self.is_pdf = is_pdf
        self.original_name = original_name
        self.dataset_names = self._get_dataset_order()
        self.summary_df = None
        self.cox_df = None

    def _get_dataset_order(self) -> List[str]:
        """
        Determine the dataset order for visualization.

        Returns:
            List[str]: Dataset names in desired plotting order.

        Raises:
            ValueError: If dataset_order contains a missing dataset.
        """
        if self.dataset_order is None:
            order = list(self.datasets_dict.keys())
        else:
            missing = [d for d in self.dataset_order if d not in self.datasets_dict]
            if missing:
                raise ValueError(f"dataset_order contains datasets absent from datasets_dict: {missing}")
            order = self.dataset_order
        order = [d for d in [self.original_name] if d in order] + [d for d in order if d != self.original_name]
        return order

    def compute_survival_metrics(self) -> pd.DataFrame:
        """
        Compute log-rank test p-values and C-index for each dataset grid panel.

        Args:
            None

        Returns:
            pd.DataFrame: DataFrame with columns ['Dataset', 'pvalue', 'C-index', 'n_A', 'n_B'].
        """
        summary_rows = []
        for ds_name in self.dataset_names:
            df_raw = self.datasets_dict[ds_name].copy()
            df = df_raw.copy()
            df[self.event_target] = pd.to_numeric(df.get(self.event_target, 0), errors="coerce").fillna(0).astype(int)
            df[self.time_target] = pd.to_numeric(df.get(self.time_target, np.nan), errors="coerce")
            df_A = df[df[self.phenotype_column] == self.value_A]
            df_B = df[df[self.phenotype_column] == self.value_B]

            n_A, n_B = len(df_A), len(df_B)
            pvalue = np.nan
            try:
                if n_A > 0 and n_B > 0:
                    gA = df_A.dropna(subset=[self.time_target, self.event_target])
                    gB = df_B.dropna(subset=[self.time_target, self.event_target])
                    if len(gA) > 0 and len(gB) > 0:
                        res = logrank_test(
                            gA[self.time_target], gB[self.time_target],
                            event_observed_A=gA[self.event_target], event_observed_B=gB[self.event_target]
                        )
                        pvalue = float(res.p_value)
            except Exception:
                pvalue = np.nan

            cindex_text = "NA"
            try:
                df_cox = df[[self.time_target, self.event_target]].copy()
                df_cox["phenotype_binary"] = pd.NA
                df_cox.loc[df[self.phenotype_column] == self.value_A, "phenotype_binary"] = 1
                df_cox.loc[df[self.phenotype_column] == self.value_B, "phenotype_binary"] = 0
                df_cox_fit = df_cox.dropna(subset=[self.time_target, "phenotype_binary"])
                df_cox_fit[self.time_target] = pd.to_numeric(df_cox_fit[self.time_target], errors="coerce")
                df_cox_fit = df_cox_fit.dropna(subset=[self.time_target])
                df_cox_fit["phenotype_binary"] = df_cox_fit["phenotype_binary"].astype(int)
                if (
                    len(df_cox_fit) > 0
                    and df_cox_fit["phenotype_binary"].nunique() > 1
                    and df_cox_fit[self.event_target].sum() > 0
                ):
                    cph = CoxPHFitter()
                    cph.fit(df_cox_fit, duration_col=self.time_target, event_col=self.event_target, show_progress=False)
                    partial_h = cph.predict_partial_hazard(df_cox_fit)
                    cindex = concordance_index(df_cox_fit[self.time_target], -partial_h, df_cox_fit[self.event_target])
                    cindex_text = f"{cindex:.3f}"
                else:
                    cindex_text = "insufficient events"
            except Exception:
                cindex_text = "fit error"

            summary_rows.append(
                {
                    "Dataset": ds_name,
                    "pvalue": (np.nan if (pvalue is None or np.isnan(pvalue)) else float(pvalue)),
                    "C-index": cindex_text,
                    "n_A": int(n_A),
                    "n_B": int(n_B),
                }
            )
        summary_df = pd.DataFrame(summary_rows, columns=["Dataset", "pvalue", "C-index", "n_A", "n_B"])
        summary_df["Dataset"] = pd.Categorical(summary_df["Dataset"], categories=self.dataset_names, ordered=True)
        summary_df = summary_df.sort_values("Dataset").reset_index(drop=True)
        self.summary_df = summary_df
        return summary_df

    def compute_survival_scores(self, original_name: Optional[str] = None) -> pd.DataFrame:
        """
        Compute the survival score, 1 - |C_original - C_synthetic|, of every dataset.

        Args:
            original_name (Optional[str]): Reference dataset for score calculation. 
                If None, uses self.original_name.

        Returns:
            pd.DataFrame: DataFrame with the additional column 'Survival_score'.

        Raises:
            KeyError: If required columns or reference row are missing.
            RuntimeError: If compute_survival_metrics() was not called prior.
        """
        if self.summary_df is None:
            raise RuntimeError("Must call compute_survival_metrics() before scoring.")
        df = self.summary_df.copy()
        ref_name = original_name or self.original_name
        if "Dataset" not in df.columns:
            raise KeyError("'Dataset' column not found.")
        if ref_name not in df["Dataset"].values:
            raise KeyError(f"Reference dataset '{ref_name}' not found in summary dataframe.")
        parsed_cindex = []
        for val in df["C-index"]:
            try:
                f = float(str(val).split()[0])
                if not math.isfinite(f):
                    f = np.nan
            except Exception:
                f = np.nan
            parsed_cindex.append(f)
        df["_cindex_parsed"] = parsed_cindex
        c_orig = df.loc[df["Dataset"] == ref_name, "_cindex_parsed"].iloc[0]
        scores = []
        for c_syn in df["_cindex_parsed"]:
            if pd.isna(c_orig) or pd.isna(c_syn):
                score = np.nan
            else:
                diff = abs(c_orig - c_syn)
                score = 1.0 - diff
                score = max(0.0, min(1.0, score))
            scores.append(score)
        df["Survival_score"] = scores
        df = df.drop(columns=["_cindex_parsed"])
        return df

    def _cox_frame(self, ds_name: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
        """
        Survival frame of one dataset restricted to the two phenotype groups.

        Args:
            ds_name (str): Dataset name.

        Returns:
            pd.DataFrame: Columns T (time), E (event, int) and group (1 for value_A, 0 for value_B).
        """
        df = self.datasets_dict[ds_name]
        d = df[df[self.phenotype_column].isin([self.value_A, self.value_B])][
            [self.time_target, self.event_target, self.phenotype_column]
        ].copy()
        d[self.time_target] = pd.to_numeric(d[self.time_target], errors="coerce")
        d[self.event_target] = pd.to_numeric(d[self.event_target], errors="coerce").fillna(0).astype(int)
        d = d.dropna()
        d["group"] = (d[self.phenotype_column] == self.value_A).astype(int)
        d = d.rename(columns={self.time_target: "T", self.event_target: "E"})
        return d[["T", "E", "group"]].reset_index(drop=True)

    @staticmethod
    def _cox_cindex(d: pd.DataFrame) -> Tuple[float, Optional[CoxPHFitter]]:
        """
        Harrell's C-index of a univariate Cox model on the phenotype group.

        Args:
            d (pd.DataFrame): Output of :meth:`_cox_frame`.

        Returns:
            tuple[float, CoxPHFitter | None]: (C-index, fitted model); (NaN, None) when the
            model cannot be fitted (one group only or no event).
        """
        if d["group"].nunique() < 2 or d["E"].sum() == 0:
            return np.nan, None
        # Near-separation of the two groups (common on bootstrap resamples) only triggers
        # convergence warnings; the fitted coefficient is still used as is.
        with warnings.catch_warnings():
            warnings.simplefilter("ignore", ConvergenceWarning)
            cph = CoxPHFitter().fit(d, "T", "E")
        return concordance_index(d["T"], -cph.predict_partial_hazard(d), d["E"]), cph

    @classmethod
    def _bootstrap_cindex(cls, d: pd.DataFrame, idx: np.ndarray) -> float:
        """C-index of one bootstrap resample, with the Cox model refitted."""
        try:
            return cls._cox_cindex(d.iloc[idx].reset_index(drop=True))[0]
        except Exception:
            return np.nan

    @classmethod
    def _cindex_ci(
        cls, d: pd.DataFrame, n_bootstrap: int, confidence_level: float, seed: int
    ) -> Tuple[float, float]:
        """Bootstrap confidence interval of the C-index."""
        res = bootstrap(
            (np.arange(len(d)),),
            lambda i: cls._bootstrap_cindex(d, i),
            vectorized=False,
            n_resamples=n_bootstrap,
            confidence_level=confidence_level,
            method="BCa",
            rng=np.random.default_rng(seed),
        )
        return float(res.confidence_interval.low), float(res.confidence_interval.high)

    def compute_cox_metrics(
        self,
        n_bootstrap: int = 1000,
        confidence_level: float = 0.95,
        seed: int = 0,
        n_jobs: int = -1,
        original_name: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> pd.DataFrame:
        """
        Absolute survival performance of every dataset and its agreement with the original.

        For each dataset, a Cox model with the phenotype group as single covariate (value_A
        coded 1) gives Harrell's C-index and the hazard ratio. The confidence interval of the
        C-index is a bootstrap interval, the Cox model being refitted on every resample.
        Against the reference dataset, ``HR_same_direction`` records whether the hazard ratio
        lies on the same side of 1, and ``Survival_score`` = 1 - |C_synthetic - C_original|.

        Args:
            n_bootstrap (int): Number of bootstrap resamples.
            confidence_level (float): Confidence level of the interval.
            seed (int): Seed of the resampling; the k-th dataset with a C-index (in plotting
                order) is resampled with seed + k.
            n_jobs (int): Parallel jobs for the bootstrap (joblib convention).
            original_name (Optional[str]): Reference dataset; defaults to self.original_name.

        Returns:
            pd.DataFrame: One row per dataset with columns Dataset, n_A, n_B, events_A,
            events_B, logrank_P, C-index, CI_low, CI_high, HR, HR_same_direction,
            Survival_score. The table is also stored in ``self.cox_df``.

        Raises:
            KeyError: If the reference dataset is not in datasets_dict.
        """
        ref_name = original_name or self.original_name
        if ref_name not in self.datasets_dict:
            raise KeyError(f"Reference dataset '{ref_name}' not found in datasets_dict.")

        frames: Dict[str, pd.DataFrame] = {}
        rows = []
        for ds_name in self.dataset_names:
            d = self._cox_frame(ds_name)
            frames[ds_name] = d
            g1, g0 = d[d["group"] == 1], d[d["group"] == 0]
            row: Dict[str, Any] = {
                "Dataset": ds_name,
                "n_A": len(g1),
                "n_B": len(g0),
                "events_A": int(g1["E"].sum()),
                "events_B": int(g0["E"].sum()),
                "logrank_P": np.nan,
                "C-index": np.nan,
                "HR": np.nan,
            }
            if len(g1) > 0 and len(g0) > 0:
                row["logrank_P"] = float(logrank_test(g1["T"], g0["T"], g1["E"], g0["E"]).p_value)
                try:
                    c, cph = self._cox_cindex(d)
                except Exception:
                    c, cph = np.nan, None
                row["C-index"] = c
                if cph is not None:
                    row["HR"] = float(np.exp(cph.params_["group"]))
            rows.append(row)
        table = pd.DataFrame(rows)

        with_c = [r["Dataset"] for r in rows if pd.notna(r["C-index"])]
        intervals = Parallel(n_jobs=n_jobs)(
            delayed(self._cindex_ci)(frames[name], n_bootstrap, confidence_level, seed + k)
            for k, name in enumerate(with_c)
        )
        ci = dict(zip(with_c, intervals))
        table["CI_low"] = [ci[n][0] if n in ci else np.nan for n in table["Dataset"]]
        table["CI_high"] = [ci[n][1] if n in ci else np.nan for n in table["Dataset"]]

        ref = table.set_index("Dataset").loc[ref_name]
        is_ref = table["Dataset"] == ref_name
        table["HR_same_direction"] = [
            float(np.sign(np.log(hr)) == np.sign(np.log(ref["HR"]))) if pd.notna(hr) else np.nan
            for hr in table["HR"]
        ]
        table["Survival_score"] = 1 - (table["C-index"] - ref["C-index"]).abs()
        table.loc[is_ref, ["HR_same_direction", "Survival_score"]] = np.nan

        table = table[[
            "Dataset", "n_A", "n_B", "events_A", "events_B", "logrank_P",
            "C-index", "CI_low", "CI_high", "HR", "HR_same_direction", "Survival_score",
        ]]
        table.attrs["confidence_level"] = confidence_level
        self.cox_df = table
        return table

    def plot_cindex_forest(
        self,
        cox_df: Optional[pd.DataFrame] = None,
        ax: Optional[plt.Axes] = None,
        title: Optional[str] = None,
        original_name: Optional[str] = None,
        figsize: Tuple[float, float] = (6, 6),
    ) -> Tuple[plt.Figure, pd.DataFrame]:
        """
        Forest plot of the C-index of every synthetic dataset with its confidence interval.

        The grey band is the confidence interval of the reference C-index, the solid line its
        point value and the dashed line C = 0.5 (no survival signal). A red cross marks a
        hazard ratio on the opposite side of 1 from the reference (reversed association).

        Args:
            cox_df (Optional[pd.DataFrame]): Output of :meth:`compute_cox_metrics`; computed
                with default settings when None and not computed before.
            ax (Optional[matplotlib.axes.Axes]): Target axis; a new figure when None.
            title (Optional[str]): Panel title; defaults to the endpoint and reference C-index.
            original_name (Optional[str]): Reference dataset; defaults to self.original_name.
            figsize (tuple[float, float]): Figure size when a new figure is created.

        Returns:
            tuple[matplotlib.figure.Figure, pd.DataFrame]: (figure, table plotted).
        """
        if cox_df is None:
            cox_df = self.cox_df
        if cox_df is None:
            cox_df = self.compute_cox_metrics(original_name=original_name)
        ref_name = original_name or self.original_name

        if ax is None:
            fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=figsize)
        else:
            fig = ax.figure

        ref = cox_df[cox_df["Dataset"] == ref_name].iloc[0]
        syn = cox_df[cox_df["Dataset"] != ref_name].reset_index(drop=True)

        if pd.notna(ref["CI_low"]):
            ax.axvspan(ref["CI_low"], ref["CI_high"], color="#bdbdbd", alpha=0.45, lw=0, zorder=0)
        if pd.notna(ref["C-index"]):
            ax.axvline(ref["C-index"], color="#4d4d4d", lw=1.4, zorder=1)
        ax.axvline(0.5, color="#d32f2f", lw=1.1, ls="--", zorder=1)

        x_lo, x_hi = 0.3, 0.9
        for i, r in syn.iterrows():
            y = -i
            color = self.dataset_colors.get(str(r["Dataset"]), "#8c8c8c")
            if pd.isna(r["C-index"]):
                ax.text(x_lo + 0.02, y, "N/A", ha="left", va="center", fontsize=7, color="#9e9e9e",
                        style="italic")
                continue
            if pd.notna(r["CI_low"]):
                ax.plot([r["CI_low"], r["CI_high"]], [y, y], color=color, lw=1.6, zorder=2)
            if r["HR_same_direction"] == 0:
                ax.plot(r["C-index"], y, marker="X", ms=8, mfc="#d32f2f", mec="white", mew=0.6,
                        zorder=3, ls="none")
            else:
                ax.plot(r["C-index"], y, marker="o", ms=5.5, mfc=color, mec="black", mew=0.7,
                        zorder=3, ls="none")

        ax.set_yticks([-i for i in range(len(syn))])
        ax.set_yticklabels(syn["Dataset"].astype(str), fontsize=9)
        ax.tick_params(axis="y", length=0)
        ax.set_ylim(-len(syn) + 0.4, 0.6)
        ax.set_xlim(x_lo, x_hi)
        ax.grid(axis="x", alpha=0.3, ls=":", lw=0.6)
        ax.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)
        ax.set_xlabel(f"C-index ({self._ci_label(cox_df)} CI)", fontsize=10)
        if title is None:
            title = f"{self.time_target}; {ref_name} C = {ref['C-index']:.2f}"
            if pd.notna(ref["CI_low"]):
                title += f" ({ref['CI_low']:.2f}–{ref['CI_high']:.2f})"
        ax.set_title(title, fontsize=10)

        handles = [
            plt.Line2D([], [], marker="o", ls="none", mfc="#bdbdbd", mec="black", ms=5.5,
                       label="Synthetic dataset"),
            plt.Line2D([], [], marker="X", ls="none", mfc="#d32f2f", mec="white", ms=8,
                       label="HR opposite to the reference"),
            mpatches.Patch(color="#bdbdbd", alpha=0.45, label=f"{ref_name} C-index CI"),
            plt.Line2D([], [], color="#d32f2f", ls="--", label="C = 0.5"),
        ]
        ax.legend(handles=handles, loc="upper center", bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.16), ncol=2,
                  fontsize=7, frameon=False)
        return fig, cox_df

    @staticmethod
    def _ci_label(cox_df: pd.DataFrame) -> str:
        """Label of the confidence level stored by compute_cox_metrics."""
        level = cox_df.attrs.get("confidence_level")
        return f"{level:.0%}" if level is not None else "bootstrap"

    def plot_grid(
        self,
        figsize: Optional[Tuple[float, float]] = (18, 6),
        show_censors: bool = True,
        ci_show: bool = False,
        title_prefix: Optional[str] = "Survival",
        dataset_strip_height: float = 0.02,
        dataset_strip_y: float = 1.01,
        save_dir: Optional[str] = None
    ) -> Tuple[plt.Figure, pd.DataFrame]:
        """
        Plot a manuscript-style grid of Kaplan–Meier survival curves for all datasets.

        Args:
            figsize (Tuple[float, float], optional): Figure dimensions (W, H).
            show_censors (bool): Whether to display censor marks.
            ci_show (bool): Whether to render CI for KM curves.
            title_prefix (str, optional): Prefix for subplot titles.
            dataset_strip_height (float): Height of colored dataset strip.
            dataset_strip_y (float): Y-position of top dataset strip.
            save_dir (str, optional): If set, save individual dataset KM curves to this folder.

        Returns:
            Tuple[plt.Figure, pd.DataFrame]: The matplotlib Figure and the summary dataframe.

        Raises:
            None
        """
        import scienceplots  # noqa: F401  (registers the "science" matplotlib styles)

        plt.style.use(["science", "nature", "notebook"])
        plt.rcParams.update({
            "font.size": 10 * self.font_scale,
            "axes.titlesize": 11 * self.font_scale,
            "axes.labelsize": 10 * self.font_scale,
            "legend.fontsize": 9 * self.font_scale,
            "xtick.labelsize": 9 * self.font_scale,
            "ytick.labelsize": 9 * self.font_scale,
            "axes.linewidth": 1.0,
            "text.usetex": False,
            "axes.edgecolor": "#333333",
            "xtick.minor.visible": False,
            "ytick.minor.visible": False,
            "xtick.top": False,
            "ytick.right": False,
        })
        fig = plt.figure(figsize=figsize)
        gs = gridspec.GridSpec(2, 4, figure=fig, wspace=0.1, hspace=0.3,
                               width_ratios=[2, 1.25, 1.25, 1.25], height_ratios=[1, 1])
        ax_origin = fig.add_subplot(gs[:, 0])
        ax_origin.set_box_aspect(1)
        axes_small = []
        for r in range(2):
            for c in range(1, 4):
                ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[r, c])
                axes_small.append(ax)
        max_small_axes = len(axes_small)
        synthetic_names = [d for d in self.dataset_names if d != self.original_name]
        color_A = self.group_colors.get("GroupA", "#0072B2")
        color_B = self.group_colors.get("GroupB", "#D55E00")

        def _plot_single(ds_name: str, ax: plt.Axes, is_large: bool = False, save: bool = False) -> None:
            """
            Plot KM curve for a single dataset.

            Args:
                ds_name (str): Dataset name.
                ax (plt.Axes): Matplotlib axes.
                is_large (bool): If True, use larger annotation and legend.
                save (bool): If True, save individual plot.

            Returns:
                None
            """
            df_raw = self.datasets_dict[ds_name].copy()
            df = df_raw.copy()
            df[self.event_target] = pd.to_numeric(df.get(self.event_target, 0), errors="coerce").fillna(0).astype(int)
            df[self.time_target] = pd.to_numeric(df.get(self.time_target, np.nan), errors="coerce")
            df_A = df[df[self.phenotype_column] == self.value_A].copy()
            df_B = df[df[self.phenotype_column] == self.value_B].copy()
            n_A, n_B = len(df_A), len(df_B)
            ds_color = self.dataset_colors.get(ds_name, "#cccccc")
            ax.add_patch(
                plt.Rectangle(
                    (0, dataset_strip_y),
                    1,
                    dataset_strip_height,
                    transform=ax.transAxes,
                    facecolor=ds_color,
                    edgecolor="none",
                    clip_on=False,
                    zorder=10,
                )
            )
            kmf = KaplanMeierFitter()
            plotted_any = False
            for group_df, label, group_color in [
                (df_B, f"{self.value_B} (n={n_B})", color_B),
                (df_A, f"{self.value_A} (n={n_A})", color_A),
            ]:
                if len(group_df) == 0 or not group_df[self.time_target].notna().any():
                    continue
                g = group_df.dropna(subset=[self.time_target, self.event_target])
                if len(g) == 0:
                    continue
                kmf.fit(g[self.time_target], event_observed=g[self.event_target], label=label)
                kmf.plot_survival_function(
                    ax=ax,
                    ci_show=ci_show,
                    show_censors=show_censors,
                    color=group_color,
                    linewidth=2.0 if is_large else 1.8,
                    censor_styles={"ms": 4, "marker": "|", "mew": 1.2} if show_censors else None,
                )
                plotted_any = True
            # Annotations
            pvalue = self.summary_df.loc[self.summary_df["Dataset"] == ds_name, "pvalue"].values[0] \
                if self.summary_df is not None else np.nan
            cindex_text = self.summary_df.loc[self.summary_df["Dataset"] == ds_name, "C-index"].values[0] \
                if self.summary_df is not None else "NA"
            ptext = "p = NA" if (pvalue is None or np.isnan(pvalue)) else f"p = {pvalue:.4g}"
            ax.text(
                0.98, 0.96, ptext, transform=ax.transAxes,
                fontsize=10 * self.font_scale,
                horizontalalignment="right", verticalalignment="top", zorder=10,
            )
            ax.text(
                0.98, 0.88, f"C-index: {cindex_text}", transform=ax.transAxes,
                fontsize=10 * self.font_scale,
                horizontalalignment="right", verticalalignment="top", zorder=10,
            )
            title_t = f"{ds_name}" if title_prefix is None else f"{title_prefix}: {ds_name}"
            ax.set_title(title_t, fontweight="bold", pad=12)
            ax.set_xlabel(f"Time ({self.time_target})")
            ax.set_ylabel("Survival probability" if is_large else "")
            ax.set_ylim(0, 1.02)
            ax.grid(True, axis="y", linestyle="--", linewidth=0.6, alpha=0.5)
            if plotted_any:
                ax.legend(
                    frameon=True, framealpha=1.0, loc="lower left",
                    bbox_to_anchor=(0, 0.02), borderaxespad=0.2,
                )
            else:
                ax.text(
                    0.5, 0.5, "No valid survival data",
                    ha="center", va="center", transform=ax.transAxes,
                    fontsize=11 * self.font_scale,
                )
                leg = ax.get_legend()
                if leg is not None:
                    leg.remove()
            if save and save_dir:
                fig_indiv = plt.figure(figsize=(6, 5))
                ax_indiv = fig_indiv.add_subplot(111)
                _plot_single(ds_name, ax_indiv, is_large=True, save=False)
                fig_indiv.tight_layout()
                if self.is_pdf:
                    outpath = os.path.join(save_dir, f"{ds_name}_KMcurve.pdf")
                else: 
                    outpath = os.path.join(save_dir, f"{ds_name}_KMcurve.png")
                fig_indiv.savefig(outpath, dpi=300)
                plt.close(fig_indiv)

        _plot_single(self.original_name, ax_origin, is_large=True, save=bool(save_dir))
        for i, ds_name in enumerate(synthetic_names):
            if i >= max_small_axes:
                break
            _plot_single(ds_name, axes_small[i], is_large=False, save=bool(save_dir))
        for j in range(len(synthetic_names), max_small_axes):
            axes_small[j].axis("off")
        plt.tight_layout()
        return fig, self.summary_df

    def __init__(
    self,
    datasets_dict: Dict[str, pd.DataFrame],
    phenotype: Dict[str, List[Any]],
    time_target: str = "OS",
    event_target: str = "OS_CNSR",
    dataset_order: Optional[List[str]] = None,
    dataset_colors: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
    group_colors: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
    font_scale: float = 1.0,
    is_pdf: bool = False,
    original_name: str = "Origin"
) -> None:
    """
    Initialize SurvivalGridEvaluator for grid-based survival comparison.

    Args:
        datasets_dict (Dict[str, pd.DataFrame]): Input datasets.
        phenotype (Dict[str, List[Any]]): {col: [value_A, value_B]}.
        time_target (str): Survival duration column.
        event_target (str): Event indicator column.
        dataset_order (List[str], optional): Custom dataset plotting order.
        dataset_colors (Dict[str, str], optional): Strip colors per dataset.
        group_colors (Dict[str, str], optional): Colors for phenotype groups.
        font_scale (float): Plot font scaling.
        is_pdf (boolean): save as pdf or png.
        original_name (str): Name of the reference dataset (default: "Origin").

    Returns:
        None

    Raises:
        ValueError: On empty datasets or invalid phenotype specification.
    """
    if not datasets_dict:
        raise ValueError("datasets_dict must not be empty.")
    if not isinstance(phenotype, dict) or len(phenotype) != 1:
        raise ValueError("phenotype must be a dict with one mapping {column_name: [valA, valB]}.")
    ph_column, ph_values = next(iter(phenotype.items()))
    if not isinstance(ph_values, (list, tuple)) or len(ph_values) != 2:
        raise ValueError("phenotype value must be a list/tuple of exactly two values: [value_A, value_B].")
    self.datasets_dict = datasets_dict
    self.phenotype_column = ph_column
    self.value_A, self.value_B = ph_values
    self.time_target = time_target
    self.event_target = event_target
    self.dataset_order = dataset_order
    self.dataset_colors = dataset_colors or DATASET_COLORS.copy()
    self.group_colors = group_colors or GROUP_COLORS.copy()
    self.font_scale = font_scale
    self.is_pdf = is_pdf
    self.original_name = original_name
    self.dataset_names = self._get_dataset_order()
    self.summary_df = None
    self.cox_df = None

    compute_cox_metrics(n_bootstrap=1000, confidence_level=0.95, seed=0, n_jobs=-1, original_name=None) ¶

    Absolute survival performance of every dataset and its agreement with the original.

    For each dataset, a Cox model with the phenotype group as single covariate (value_A coded 1) gives Harrell's C-index and the hazard ratio. The confidence interval of the C-index is a bootstrap interval, the Cox model being refitted on every resample. Against the reference dataset, HR_same_direction records whether the hazard ratio lies on the same side of 1, and Survival_score = 1 - |C_synthetic - C_original|.

    Parameters:

    Name Type Description Default
    n_bootstrap int

    Number of bootstrap resamples.

    		 1000
    confidence_level float

    Confidence level of the interval.

    		 0.95
    seed int

    Seed of the resampling; the k-th dataset with a C-index (in plotting order) is resampled with seed + k.

    		 0
    n_jobs int

    Parallel jobs for the bootstrap (joblib convention).

    		 -1
    original_name Optional[str]

    Reference dataset; defaults to self.original_name.

    def compute_cox_metrics(
    self,
    n_bootstrap: int = 1000,
    confidence_level: float = 0.95,
    seed: int = 0,
    n_jobs: int = -1,
    original_name: Optional[str] = None,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    Absolute survival performance of every dataset and its agreement with the original.

    For each dataset, a Cox model with the phenotype group as single covariate (value_A
    coded 1) gives Harrell's C-index and the hazard ratio. The confidence interval of the
    C-index is a bootstrap interval, the Cox model being refitted on every resample.
    Against the reference dataset, ``HR_same_direction`` records whether the hazard ratio
    lies on the same side of 1, and ``Survival_score`` = 1 - |C_synthetic - C_original|.

    Args:
        n_bootstrap (int): Number of bootstrap resamples.
        confidence_level (float): Confidence level of the interval.
        seed (int): Seed of the resampling; the k-th dataset with a C-index (in plotting
            order) is resampled with seed + k.
        n_jobs (int): Parallel jobs for the bootstrap (joblib convention).
        original_name (Optional[str]): Reference dataset; defaults to self.original_name.

    Returns:
        pd.DataFrame: One row per dataset with columns Dataset, n_A, n_B, events_A,
        events_B, logrank_P, C-index, CI_low, CI_high, HR, HR_same_direction,
        Survival_score. The table is also stored in ``self.cox_df``.

    Raises:
        KeyError: If the reference dataset is not in datasets_dict.
    """
    ref_name = original_name or self.original_name
    if ref_name not in self.datasets_dict:
        raise KeyError(f"Reference dataset '{ref_name}' not found in datasets_dict.")

    frames: Dict[str, pd.DataFrame] = {}
    rows = []
    for ds_name in self.dataset_names:
        d = self._cox_frame(ds_name)
        frames[ds_name] = d
        g1, g0 = d[d["group"] == 1], d[d["group"] == 0]
        row: Dict[str, Any] = {
            "Dataset": ds_name,
            "n_A": len(g1),
            "n_B": len(g0),
            "events_A": int(g1["E"].sum()),
            "events_B": int(g0["E"].sum()),
            "logrank_P": np.nan,
            "C-index": np.nan,
            "HR": np.nan,
        }
        if len(g1) > 0 and len(g0) > 0:
            row["logrank_P"] = float(logrank_test(g1["T"], g0["T"], g1["E"], g0["E"]).p_value)
            try:
                c, cph = self._cox_cindex(d)
            except Exception:
                c, cph = np.nan, None
            row["C-index"] = c
            if cph is not None:
                row["HR"] = float(np.exp(cph.params_["group"]))
        rows.append(row)
    table = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    with_c = [r["Dataset"] for r in rows if pd.notna(r["C-index"])]
    intervals = Parallel(n_jobs=n_jobs)(
        delayed(self._cindex_ci)(frames[name], n_bootstrap, confidence_level, seed + k)
        for k, name in enumerate(with_c)
    )
    ci = dict(zip(with_c, intervals))
    table["CI_low"] = [ci[n][0] if n in ci else np.nan for n in table["Dataset"]]
    table["CI_high"] = [ci[n][1] if n in ci else np.nan for n in table["Dataset"]]

    ref = table.set_index("Dataset").loc[ref_name]
    is_ref = table["Dataset"] == ref_name
    table["HR_same_direction"] = [
        float(np.sign(np.log(hr)) == np.sign(np.log(ref["HR"]))) if pd.notna(hr) else np.nan
        for hr in table["HR"]
    ]
    table["Survival_score"] = 1 - (table["C-index"] - ref["C-index"]).abs()
    table.loc[is_ref, ["HR_same_direction", "Survival_score"]] = np.nan

    table = table[[
        "Dataset", "n_A", "n_B", "events_A", "events_B", "logrank_P",
        "C-index", "CI_low", "CI_high", "HR", "HR_same_direction", "Survival_score",
    ]]
    table.attrs["confidence_level"] = confidence_level
    self.cox_df = table
    return table

    def compute_survival_metrics(self) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    Compute log-rank test p-values and C-index for each dataset grid panel.

    Args:
        None

    Returns:
        pd.DataFrame: DataFrame with columns ['Dataset', 'pvalue', 'C-index', 'n_A', 'n_B'].
    """
    summary_rows = []
    for ds_name in self.dataset_names:
        df_raw = self.datasets_dict[ds_name].copy()
        df = df_raw.copy()
        df[self.event_target] = pd.to_numeric(df.get(self.event_target, 0), errors="coerce").fillna(0).astype(int)
        df[self.time_target] = pd.to_numeric(df.get(self.time_target, np.nan), errors="coerce")
        df_A = df[df[self.phenotype_column] == self.value_A]
        df_B = df[df[self.phenotype_column] == self.value_B]

        n_A, n_B = len(df_A), len(df_B)
        pvalue = np.nan
        try:
            if n_A > 0 and n_B > 0:
                gA = df_A.dropna(subset=[self.time_target, self.event_target])
                gB = df_B.dropna(subset=[self.time_target, self.event_target])
                if len(gA) > 0 and len(gB) > 0:
                    res = logrank_test(
                        gA[self.time_target], gB[self.time_target],
                        event_observed_A=gA[self.event_target], event_observed_B=gB[self.event_target]
                    )
                    pvalue = float(res.p_value)
        except Exception:
            pvalue = np.nan

        cindex_text = "NA"
        try:
            df_cox = df[[self.time_target, self.event_target]].copy()
            df_cox["phenotype_binary"] = pd.NA
            df_cox.loc[df[self.phenotype_column] == self.value_A, "phenotype_binary"] = 1
            df_cox.loc[df[self.phenotype_column] == self.value_B, "phenotype_binary"] = 0
            df_cox_fit = df_cox.dropna(subset=[self.time_target, "phenotype_binary"])
            df_cox_fit[self.time_target] = pd.to_numeric(df_cox_fit[self.time_target], errors="coerce")
            df_cox_fit = df_cox_fit.dropna(subset=[self.time_target])
            df_cox_fit["phenotype_binary"] = df_cox_fit["phenotype_binary"].astype(int)
            if (
                len(df_cox_fit) > 0
                and df_cox_fit["phenotype_binary"].nunique() > 1
                and df_cox_fit[self.event_target].sum() > 0
            ):
                cph = CoxPHFitter()
                cph.fit(df_cox_fit, duration_col=self.time_target, event_col=self.event_target, show_progress=False)
                partial_h = cph.predict_partial_hazard(df_cox_fit)
                cindex = concordance_index(df_cox_fit[self.time_target], -partial_h, df_cox_fit[self.event_target])
                cindex_text = f"{cindex:.3f}"
            else:
                cindex_text = "insufficient events"
        except Exception:
            cindex_text = "fit error"

        summary_rows.append(
            {
                "Dataset": ds_name,
                "pvalue": (np.nan if (pvalue is None or np.isnan(pvalue)) else float(pvalue)),
                "C-index": cindex_text,
                "n_A": int(n_A),
                "n_B": int(n_B),
            }
        )
    summary_df = pd.DataFrame(summary_rows, columns=["Dataset", "pvalue", "C-index", "n_A", "n_B"])
    summary_df["Dataset"] = pd.Categorical(summary_df["Dataset"], categories=self.dataset_names, ordered=True)
    summary_df = summary_df.sort_values("Dataset").reset_index(drop=True)
    self.summary_df = summary_df
    return summary_df

    def compute_survival_scores(self, original_name: Optional[str] = None) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    Compute the survival score, 1 - |C_original - C_synthetic|, of every dataset.

    Args:
        original_name (Optional[str]): Reference dataset for score calculation. 
            If None, uses self.original_name.

    Returns:
        pd.DataFrame: DataFrame with the additional column 'Survival_score'.

    Raises:
        KeyError: If required columns or reference row are missing.
        RuntimeError: If compute_survival_metrics() was not called prior.
    """
    if self.summary_df is None:
        raise RuntimeError("Must call compute_survival_metrics() before scoring.")
    df = self.summary_df.copy()
    ref_name = original_name or self.original_name
    if "Dataset" not in df.columns:
        raise KeyError("'Dataset' column not found.")
    if ref_name not in df["Dataset"].values:
        raise KeyError(f"Reference dataset '{ref_name}' not found in summary dataframe.")
    parsed_cindex = []
    for val in df["C-index"]:
        try:
            f = float(str(val).split()[0])
            if not math.isfinite(f):
                f = np.nan
        except Exception:
            f = np.nan
        parsed_cindex.append(f)
    df["_cindex_parsed"] = parsed_cindex
    c_orig = df.loc[df["Dataset"] == ref_name, "_cindex_parsed"].iloc[0]
    scores = []
    for c_syn in df["_cindex_parsed"]:
        if pd.isna(c_orig) or pd.isna(c_syn):
            score = np.nan
        else:
            diff = abs(c_orig - c_syn)
            score = 1.0 - diff
            score = max(0.0, min(1.0, score))
        scores.append(score)
    df["Survival_score"] = scores
    df = df.drop(columns=["_cindex_parsed"])
    return df
